tools.name: daypass_status
tools.description: Show whether a Daypass lease is open, for which database, and how long is left.

tools.name: list_tables
tools.description: List tables with estimated row counts in the schemas this lease may see.

tools.name: describe_table
tools.description: Columns, types, nullability and indexes for one table.

tools.name: query
tools.description: Run one read-only SELECT against the leased database. Hard limits: one statement, SELECT only, 10 s, 500 rows. Some columns (PII, secrets) are hidden, so SELECT * fails on those tables: use describe_table and name columns. Use explain first on big tables.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Show the query plan (EXPLAIN, never ANALYZE) for a SELECT so you can check its cost before running it.

sql.description: A single SELECT statement (without the EXPLAIN keyword)
